stories.title: Yemen's Houthis reportedly seize strategic Red Sea port of Mokha
stories.body: Mokha's capture would bring the Iran-backed group closer to controlling the Bab al-Mandab Strait waterway, a key shipping route.

stories.title: Can Trump really pay $5,000 to every American adult?
stories.body: Analysts question if the US president's election year offer is workable, legal or affordable.

stories.title: Pilot warned Amazon cargo plane going too fast before deadly crash, data shows
stories.body: One pilot told the other about the aircraft's "excessive speed" but received an uneven response even as alarms sounded.

stories.title: Israel's Netanyahu to sue newspaper over claim UAE warned him of 7 October attack
stories.body: The paper said it stood by its reporting, after publishing extracts from a book where the claim appears.

stories.title: More than 20 children killed in DR Congo school fire
stories.body: Officials say there was a stampede as they fled a fire that engulfed two schools in the eastern rebel-held city of Bukavu.

stories.title: Man jailed after threatening to kill son's teacher in French village
stories.body: The father had threatened to behead a female primary school teacher near Toulouse.

stories.title: Coach crash kills several people in Swiss Alps
stories.body: A coach carrying 48 Dutch passengers overturns, leaving several people dead.

stories.title: Royal family rift after popular TV news presenter chosen to succeed Ugandan king
stories.body: King Oyo's family say he left a will naming his young son as heir to the Tooro kingdom.

stories.title: Apple's new boss starts with big gamble on £1,999 first folding iPhone
stories.body: Apple showed off at an event the first major design change to the iPhone in almost 20 years.

stories.title: Twenty-five dead after fire on cargo ship in eastern China
stories.body: Of the 42 people on board, 17 were were evacuated, CCTV reports.

stories.title: Iran war won't end until after crucial November elections, says Trump
stories.body: The president also said oil prices won't come down until after the November races, claiming without evidence that Iran wants to impact the election.

stories.title: Spanish intelligence warned of Ceuta mass crossing plans before surge
stories.body: Declassified documents show Spanish and Moroccan authorities were alerted to social media calls for a mass migrant crossing the day before tens of thousands entered Ceuta.

stories.title: 'We never recovered him': Quest to identify remains from Ground Zero continues
stories.body: Since the attacks, New York officials are working with new, complex technology to find traces of more than 1,000 victims.

stories.title: Russia's new jet-powered drones outpacing Ukraine's air defences with daily launches
stories.body: The new models can travel at speeds of up to 300mph, faster than Ukraine's air defence interceptors.

stories.title: Four key takeaways from Republican midterms convention
stories.body: The US president covered many of the subjects he has returned to time and again - with a few surprises thrown in.

stories.title: 'People were trampling me': Philippine ferry fire survivor recalls narrow escape
stories.body: A survivor has told the BBC of the chaos onboard as the ferry caught fire near the popular tourist spot of Coron.

stories.title: Why some experts increasingly fear AI will take over
stories.body: AI agents went on an uncontrolled hacking spree, leaving some in the industry worried

stories.title: Watch: Is Trump's $5,000 election pledge legal?
stories.body: The US president has said every American will get $5,000 (£3,700) if the Republican Party wins November's midterms.

stories.title: Watch: How a community living under demolition orders from Israel view UK sanctions
stories.body: Middle East Correspondent Lucy Williamson visits the Palestinian community of Khan al Ahmar, and the neighbouring Israeli settlement of Maale Admumim.

stories.title: Watch: Do Republicans blame Trump for high oil prices?
stories.body: The BBC's Sarah Smith is at the Republican Party's first midterms convention in Texas, taking place as oil prices rise to $100 (£74) a barrel.
